info.title: Frontmost AI API
info.description: Read how AI apps answer your buyers' questions, and change the questions Frontmost AI asks.

bearer.description: A workspace API key (fmk_…) from the Team page, or an OAuth access token for this API.

post.summary: Create a project from a website, or continue a setup

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required when the body has no setup_id. A new random string for each new request.

domain.description: The website to track, such as example.com

setup_id.description: The setup to continue, from the reply that said to wait

questions.description: Your own first questions, in place of the ones Frontmost AI writes
